posts.title: Ugreen Nexode Air Slim Charger (100W)
posts.description: The Ugreen Nexode Air Slim Charger (100W) is a flat 3-port GaN charger with two 100W USB-C ports and a 22.5W USB-A port. I paid about S$45 on Shopee for my carry-on gadget pouch.

posts.title: UniFi Travel Router (UTR)
posts.description: I finally got the UniFi Travel Router (UTR) for S$149 from TGN Technology, as it is not on the Singapore UI Store yet. It is credit card-sized, weighs 89g, and is only Wi-Fi 5.

posts.title: Epomaker TH80 V2
posts.description: Epomaker sent me the TH80 V2, a 75% tri-mode wireless mechanical keyboard retailing at US$68.99. I chose Black Grey with linear Creamy Jade switches. Hot-swappable, gasket-mounted, with an 8,000mAh battery.
